december-2026.title: Good Days Out in December 2026: Holiday Lights and Warm Indoor Outings
december-2026.description: Holiday lights, Christmas on Main Street and warm indoor outings for older adults in Springfield, Branson and St. Charles County this December.
december-2026.intro: December is full of lights, music and Christmas on Main Street. Here are our picks for a good day out this month in the three areas where Neighbors are starting now, plus a few warm indoor places for the colder days. Many light displays are drive-through, so they are easy outings for anyone who would rather stay in the car.

areas.name: Springfield and Ozark
areas.tip: Gardens Aglow has level, lit paths with benches, and fire pits for warming up.

areas.name: Branson and Table Rock Lake
areas.tip: Silver Dollar City has trams and buses from free parking to the entrance. A shorter visit at dusk, when the lights come on, can be just right.

areas.name: St. Charles County
areas.reel_title: Good days out in St. Charles County
areas.tip: The free St. Charles Trolley runs Friday through Sunday until December 20 and has a lift for wheelchairs, scooters and walkers. It is an easy way to see Christmas Traditions on Main Street without long walks.
